detail:
src/embeddings/embedder.ts downloads Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 from huggingface.co on first semantic use when .twining/models/ is empty. The `offline` flag that prevents it has exactly ONE caller that sets it: src/cli/twining.ts:420 (the hook path). src/server.ts:48 calls createTwiningContext(projectRoot) with no options, so offline defaults to false on the MCP server path.

The only env vars src/** reads are CI, DO_NOT_TRACK, POSTHOG_API_KEY, TWINING_AUTO_MIGRATE, TWINING_DISABLED, VITEST. There is no TWINING_OFFLINE and no config key. An operator on an air-gapped or policy-restricted machine cannot turn the download off without editing code.

R18 asks for a tested configuration for a local/approved-provider deployment; there is no configuration surface to test. C28 A24 requires every outbound destination and first-use model download be confirmed by observed traffic — the destination is confirmed by source reading (docs/operations/data-flow.md path 1) but the control does not exist.

Suggested fix (owner: whoever owns src/core/context.ts): read TWINING_OFFLINE and a config.embeddings.offline key in createTwiningContext, and default offline to true when the model cache is absent and there is no interactive consent.

Related, lower severity: F-TELEMETRY-KEY — a PostHog project key is baked into the build by scripts/inject-posthog-key.mjs, so "no telemetry" rests on a runtime flag rather than on the absence of a credential. Inert while config.telemetry.enabled is false, but worth stating in the operator docs.
summary: F-OFFLINE: the MCP server path cannot disable the first-use Hugging Face model download — no env var, no config key, offline defaults to false
